primary.title: Who wins from cheaper oil? These sectors could see the biggest earnings surprise
primary.summary: As West Asia heads for peace, after over 100 days of war, market participants expect a wide range of industries to gain from a return to normalcy, even as they keep a wary eye on the durability of a peace deal that is yet to be signed
